notes.title: Demo Patch Notes 0.4.006
notes.notes:
Hi there! ~~🎉👋 

We hope you’re having fun with the Demo!


In this patch, we’re introducing several system reworks, texture and animation updates, and a new Crimson Knight ability.

Major Changes

 Added new Animation + VFX to Crimson Knight's abilities
 Added new Crimson Knight Ability: Bloodshatter
 Reworked Tenderize to summon a Void Vortex that travels forwards
 Reworked the looting system. Enemies and destructible objects will now drop a pouch containing all their loot on the ground, which can then be picked up.

 Dev Note: With this looting systems, players can now inspect items before picking them up. New Stat added: Skill
 Skill is a new implicit modifier that combines the old implicit modifiers namely Life, Power, Essence and Armor into one Stat. 
 All proc-based modifiers have been grouped into a new category called Extra Effect Modifiers, indicated by a pink circle in the Equipment inspect window
 Lowered the amount of modifiers on Equipments

 Common: 0 Prefixes and 0 Suffixes
 Rare: Either 1 Prefix or 1 Suffix
 Epic: 1 Prefix and 1 Suffix
 Heirloom: Either 1 Prefix and 2 Suffixes or 2 Prefixes and 1 Suffix (Has a chance to roll an additional Effect Modifier)
 Legendary: 2 Prefixes and 2 Suffixes (Has a chance to roll an additional Effect Modifier)
 Mythical: 2 Prefixes and 2 Suffixes (Has a chance to roll up to two additional Effect Modifiers)
 Dev Note: Loading old save files will transform your old Equipments to feature the new modifier system. That being said, the Equipments will still feature the same amount of modifiers they had with the old system (so you will not lose any modifiers). Any Equipments dropped from that point onwards will follow the new system.
 Resistance Rework:

 Fire, Frost and Lightning Resistance have been merged into Elemental Resistance
 Corruption Resistance has been removed
 New Resistance: Abyssal Resistance
 Damage Type Rework:

 Fire, Frost and Lightning damage now grant Elemental damage
 Bleed damage has been converted into Physical damage

 Dev Note: Many players thought bleed damage scales off physical damage which caused a lot of confusion, that's why we are simplifying things and merging them into one damage type.
 Corruption Damage has been removed
 Updated the textures of Molten Depths



Balance Changes

Reduced the amount of Equipments that drop by 25%
Adventure-mode health and damage scaling increased by 43%
Buffed non-boss enemy damage by 10%
 Flamebound Guardian
Health increased by 12%
Prophecy of Flames damage buffed by 50%
Ruination damage buffed by 25%
They Who Hid
Health increased by 10% in Phase 1
Condensed Darkness
Health increased by 33%
Movement Speed increased by 15%
Fiend
Removed indicator on Tantrum
Reduced damage of Tantrum by 33%
Corruptor
Health reduced by 15%
Nerfed chest inherit item quantity by 50%
Nerfed chest chance to roll Equipments by 25%



Bug Fixes and Minor Changes

Minor Changes

Enemy Health Bars now display buffs
Updated the lighting inside the Charred Woods, Molten Depths and The Discard
Updated some monster SFX


Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue where enemy health bars would not display stacks of debuffs properly
Beta Tester Crown should only be available via a valid Beta Tester Key (sorry for the confusion)
Fixed a bug where Felya would not spawn after killing Magmadon for the first time
Fixed a bug where adventure mode was scaling much more aggressively than intended
Fixed a bug that caused old saves to lose certain Equipements
Fixed a bug that made "Velkash, Grips of the Shattered Host" unobtainable
Fixed a bug where Epics and Rares would not keep their names after loading a save file
Many other small bug fixes



Wishing you all the best
Bardh & Burim

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes 0.2.101
notes.notes:
Hi there! ~~🎉👋 

We hope you’re having as much fun playing the demo as we had creating it!

While perfection is an ever-moving target, we've made some adjustments to keep the game balanced and enjoyable for everyone.

Thank you so much for all the feedback you’ve shared with us—we truly appreciate it! 💖
If you’d like to be part of future playtesting for new content, be sure to join our Discord server:
https://discord.gg/UxxHnffkkJ



Here’s a detailed breakdown of all the changes we’ve made since the demo's release:

Major Changes

The game is now playable on ultrawide screens! While we don’t support ultrawide resolutions yet, players who previously couldn't access the game on ultrawide setups should now be able to enjoy it.
Added 4k Resolution support
The Layout for the Lost Woods was updated.
Re-placed all of the Key Items in the Demo.
Shortened the Dungeon and removed some enemies.


Balance Changes

Nerfed non-boss enemy health by 20%
Nerfed non-boss enemy damage by 10%
 Dark Harbinger
Health reduced by 33%
Prophecy of Ruin damage nerfed by 85%
Prophecy of Ruin cooldown increased by 25%
Ruination damage nerfed by 50%
 Chief Corruptor Kor'vax
Health reduced by 15%
Reduced the range on Shatter by 25%
They Who Hid
Health Reduced by 10%
Condensed Darkness
Health increased by 33%
Movement Speed increased by 15%
Manifestation
Health reduced by 15%
Damage reduced by 10%
Fiend
Increased the cooldown of Tantrum by 25%
Reduced the chance of casting Tantrum by 15%
Corruptor
Health reduced by 25%
Hungering Giant
Crush now has a 10 yard range
Reduced the cooldown of Defile by 25%
Book of Mastery now grants 2 Mastery Points instead of 1
Reduced the amount of Loot that drops by 15%
Nerfed chest inherit item quantity by 50%
Increased minimum level for Epic loot by 1



Bug Fixes and Minor Changes

Minor Changes

Added a hint telling players to create a character before starting the game
Updated the lighting inside the Lost Woods
The damage scaling for very early levels has been significantly reduced to create a better balance between players who get lucky with loot early on and those who are less fortunate.
Added new sound effects to enemy deaths
Updated most of the sound effects
Updated music


Bug Fixes

Beta Tester Crown should only be available via a valid Beta Tester Key (sorry for the confusion)
Fixed all bugs related to resolutions not working properly
Fixed a bug where enemies would get permanently stunned by Crimson Rain
Fixed a bug that allowed you to travel to the final boss from the waypoint inside Light's Refuge
Fixed a bug where sound effects were playing at a higher volume than intended
Removed ability specific modifiers on gear that are not supported in the current version



Wishing you all the best and a wonderful holiday season,
Bardh & Burim
